en: Colorized street view of an early 20th‑century city with tram tracks running down the center, horse‑drawn carriages, pedestrians in period clothing, and multi‑story buildings with shops on both sides. Palm trees and street lamps line the road, which leads toward the sea in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location as a street in Patras. A website watermark appears at the bottom.
